cross_cutting_mbo_finding.headline: Three separate defects in this block are all the SAME defect wearing different clothes: a never-masked field that is nonetheless not telling the truth about the session it describes. C found the frozen one. I found a LIVE-but-internally-inconsistent one and a CORRECT-but-mis-scoped one. None of the three is catchable by state_health, because nothing is empty.

finding_1_the_tape_basis_changes_store_m.statement: tape_conditions.source_store is nymex_cont_n0 for the sessions 0605 through 0616 and nymex_cont_n1 for 0617 and 0618. Both are never-masked and both are served under the same field names. Volume across that boundary: n0 week 1 74,362-110,168 lots; n0 week 2 (0615, 0616) 12,041 and 12,321; n1 (0617, 0618) 37,588 and 46,452.
finding_1_the_tape_basis_changes_store_m.why_it_matters: E handed forward, correctly for its own purposes, 'week-2 sessions run 6.6x thinner at double the spread - B must NOT compare Monday's flow magnitudes against my week-1 numbers.' That ratio is measured on the n0 leg. Applied literally to the WHOLE of week 2 it is wrong by a factor of three on the two sessions that matter to me: 0618, my D-1, is 46,452 lots, roughly half a week-1 session, and its phase flows (+201 / +2,192 / -2,394) are week-1 SCALE, not the +-300 to +-650 the n0 week-2 sessions run.
finding_1_the_tape_basis_changes_store_m.the_precise_restatement: E's caveat is CORRECT and same-basis for 0615 and 0616 (n0 leg genuinely 7x thinner, spread_ticks_med 1.0 -> 2.0, no store change involved) and B should use it. It becomes an ARTIFACT from 0617 onward, where the thinning is a store change rather than a participation collapse. Whoever owns 0617/0618 and I on 0619 must NOT crush our magnitude bands by 6.6x.
finding_1_the_tape_basis_changes_store_m.what_I_did_with_it: I derived my 0619 holiday sigma from the frozen n0 anchor sigma scaled by a HOLIDAY participation factor, and I did not additionally apply any week-2 thinning factor. Applying both would have double-counted a discount that the n1 sessions do not support.
finding_1_the_tape_basis_changes_store_m.what_I_could_not_resolve: Which futures leg each store carries. front_symbol_calendar is NGN26 on all ten days (E verified) and calendar_front_expiry is 2026-06-26, so the calendar front never changes. Resolving why the served store flips at 0617 requires opening the tape, which is outside my input set. I am reporting the observable and the scoping consequence, not a leg diagnosis.
finding_1_the_tape_basis_changes_store_m.general_form: A never-masked series can change its own BASIS mid-block with no flag in the field the reader consumes. The handoff carried a ratio computed ACROSS that change and it propagated as a scalar. Any magnitude caveat expressed as a RATIO must name the store it was measured on.

finding_2_three_never_masked_calendar_de.statement: For 20260619 the state serves holiday.effect = 'closed', flow_calendar.cme_session_class = 'partial_session', flow_calendar.is_cme_business_day = false, and flow_calendar.cme_early_close = FALSE. Three descriptors, three different pictures: fully closed, partially open, and open-without-an-early-close.
finding_2_three_never_masked_calendar_de.verified_not_a_one_off: The identical signature appears on G20's Memorial Day 20260525 (holiday.effect 'closed', cme_session_class 'partial_session', cme_early_close false). So it is the feed's standing convention for a CME holiday, not a G21 corruption. Memorial Day 0525 then traded, on ~30% participation, with a realized range of 1,140 - so 'closed' is the field that is wrong, and 'partial_session' is the field that is right.
finding_2_three_never_masked_calendar_de.why_it_matters_and_it_is_not_cosmetic: It is a PATH question, and the path is half of what I emit. If the session halts at an early close, my p50 curve must terminate there and the day-move is measured to an early settle; if it runs to 17:00 it does not. cme_early_close reading FALSE on a session that cme_session_class calls partial is the one combination that cannot be true of both. I resolved it toward 'partial session with an early halt' on the strength of the 0525 precedent and stated the assumption in my path_note rather than silently picking one.
finding_2_three_never_masked_calendar_de.consistency_check_that_passed: flow_calendar.days_to_futures_expiry is 5 on BOTH 0618 and 0619, which is only consistent if the counter is in CME BUSINESS days and is correctly excluding 0619 itself. So is_cme_business_day = false is being honored downstream. The defect is confined to the human-readable descriptors, which is exactly why it survives.
finding_2_three_never_masked_calendar_de.recommendation_for_the_post_mortem: A holiday session needs ONE authoritative field for its trading window. Until then a holiday owner should state which descriptor it resolved to and why, as I have.

finding_3_the_gap_ownership_LADDER_is_st.statement: magnitude.block_gap_ownership's weather rung, and the s101_6 NEAR-SUM ladder that sizes it, are keyed end-to-end on gw-HDD. In this block absolute gw_hdd runs 0.02 to 0.75. The play's own warm-cut headroom gate voids weather content below ~13.5 ABSOLUTE gw-HDD; this block sits roughly THIRTEEN UNITS below that boundary on every horizon.
finding_3_the_gap_ownership_LADDER_is_st.measured_on_the_0614_seam: The sunday_reopen cycle batch (asof 2026-06-14T17:59 ET, decision-time-legit before the 18:00 reopen) delivered HDD deltas +0.067 / +0.031 / +0.233 / +0.101 / +0.239 / +0.087 over D0..D+5. NEAR-SUM over D0..D+4 = +0.671, which lands in the PRICED arm (+200..+400 up). That number is arithmetically well-formed and physically meaningless: it is 0.67 gw-HDD in the third week of June.
finding_3_the_gap_ownership_LADDER_is_st.the_actual_June_demand_channel_is_CDD_an: The state serves forecast_gw_cdd 8.129 and forecast_run_delta_cdd +0.522 for 0615 (9.725 and +0.399 for 0619). There is no CDD arm anywhere in block_gap_ownership, weekend_gap_delivery, or the NEAR-SUM ladder.
finding_3_the_gap_ownership_LADDER_is_st.what_I_did: I followed C's precedent exactly and did NOT invent a CDD threshold. I declared the weather rung INOPERABLE for the 0614 seam rather than run the HDD ladder to a spurious PRICED verdict, and I recorded the consequence: with the weather rung inoperable, positioning_saturation_turn declining, anchor_structural absent and chain_drift unassertable, the ownership ladder returns NO OWNER for the 0614 gap. That is the honest end state and B needs to know the ladder is silent rather than being handed a fabricated +200..+400.
finding_3_the_gap_ownership_LADDER_is_st.why_this_is_a_finding_and_not_a_complain: G21 is the walk's first genuinely summer block with a weekend inside it. The ladder has never been asked this question before. Its silence is a NAMED GAP with a cheap falsifiable test - re-score the HDD ladder's verdicts on every May-September weekend the walk reaches and see whether they carry any gap sign at all - and it should be recorded as a gap rather than papered over with an HDD number nobody believes.

finding_4_the_thin_tape_guard_cuts_both_.statement: flow.big_print_bshare_thin_tape_guard is written as a BUY-side bar-raiser: below ~20 big prints, raise 0.55 to ~0.60. But its mechanism is a DISPERSION measurement (thinnest quartile sd 0.255 versus 0.132/0.120/0.127) and dispersion is symmetric. The mirror bar on the sell side is therefore ~0.40, and no play states it.
finding_4_the_thin_tape_guard_cuts_both_.why_I_needed_it: My D-1 (0618) reads big_print_b_share 0.303 size-weighted on 19 big prints. Nineteen prints puts it squarely in the guard's thin quartile. 0.303 is 0.197 away from 0.50, which is only 0.77 standard deviations on that quartile's dispersion - so read naively as 'big prints selling hard' it would be over-claimed. Read against the derived mirror bar of ~0.40 it clears, but modestly. I down-weighted the tell accordingly instead of leaning on it.
finding_4_the_thin_tape_guard_cuts_both_.status: I am NOT proposing a play. I am recording that I applied a DERIVED mirror bar, labelled as derived, because the merged text does not supply one, and that the derivation is the play's own symmetric dispersion measurement rather than anything new. If the merge wants it, the falsifiable test is the same one the play already ran, run on the low tail.

magnitude_derivation.step_1_the_sigma_basis: vol_regime is frozen at the 0605 anchor on the n0 basis: n0_net_sigma_20 = 862, n0_net_sigma_10 = 1,058, n0_net_sigma_5 = 1,117, n0_range_20_mean = 1,266. I use the 20-session sigma, 862, as the regime ruler.
magnitude_derivation.step_2_holiday_participation_scaling_NET: daytype.thin_session_range_invariance - my own merged play - says a thin session compresses NET and does NOT compress RANGE, and that scaling BOTH by sqrt(participation) is wrong on the range half. So I scale the NET only. G20's Memorial Day realized ~30% participation. I take 0.35 for 0619: slightly higher than 0.30 because a roll deadline at dte 5 facing a truncated close PULLS flow into the session rather than removing it. sqrt(0.35) = 0.592. Holiday net sigma = 862 x 0.592 = 510.
magnitude_derivation.step_3_the_p50_fraction: 0.35 sigma. Justification, not fit: the day has NO scheduled catalyst, and its D-1 produced ZERO net aggregate aggressor flow (-1 lot on 46,452), so there is no directional fuel handed forward - only a final-phase force. magnitude.catalyst_condition_sort's three up-size conditions (weekend-gap Monday, storage Thursday, swing-reversal seam) all fail on 0619, so nothing licenses a larger fraction. -510 x 0.35 = -179.
magnitude_derivation.independent_cross_check_that_I_did_not_f: The walk carries exactly two holiday-partial-session instances and both are small: G20 0525 Memorial Day realized +30 (0.08 sigma), and daytype.monday_weekend_gap's stated EXCEPTION instance 1013 Columbus Day realized -300 ('thin-holiday with NO active weather catalyst = quiet, size DOWN'). The empirical holiday bracket is |net| 30 to 300. My sigma-path derivation lands at 180, inside that bracket, having never consulted it. The two roads are independent - one is a variance scaling, the other is two realized days - and they agree.
magnitude_derivation.band_lower: -180 minus 0.9 x 510 = -639, rounded -640. A coherent roll-driven sell running unopposed in a holiday book is the realistic downside.
magnitude_derivation.band_upper: -180 plus 1.45 x 510 = +560. The upper reach is DELIBERATELY fatter than the lower. daytype.covering_giveback_self_limiting states it in its own words: 'An expiry the week ahead = squeeze TAIL risk (fat upper tail), not a p50 covering trigger.' Expiry is exactly the week ahead (0626, dte 5), the managed-money short sits at a 2.83 1y percentile, and squeeze_watch limb 2 is unverifiable rather than negative. That is a tail, and I have put it in the tail instead of in the p50 - which is precisely the correction the G19 post-mortem made when it re-classed crowded-short as TAIL and not p50 driver.
magnitude_derivation.what_I_deliberately_did_NOT_do: I did not apply E's 6.6x week-2 thinning factor on top of the holiday factor. Per cross_cutting finding 1 that ratio is measured on the n0 store and my D-1 sits on n1 at 46,452 lots with week-1-scale phase flows. Stacking both discounts would have driven my number to roughly -30 and dressed a double-counted artifact as conviction.

days.path_note: TWO things about this curve that a scorer needs. (1) EARLY CLOSE: 0619 is a partial session and I have resolved the three-way descriptor conflict (see cross_cutting finding 2) toward an early halt in the 13:00-13:30 ET region. The 12:00 -> 14:00 segment therefore compresses the day's final ~60 minutes of trading, and the 14:00 and 16:00 points carry the early-settle level FLAT because there is no tape there. They are not forecasts of an afternoon; they are a closed market. (2) THE EXCURSION IS DELIBERATELY LARGER THAN THE NET: p50 low -460 against a day-net of -180 is a 2.6x ratio, and that is daytype.thin_session_range_invariance applied to its own second instance. On G20 0525 I initially characterised the excursion as a reactive tail, then withdrew that in round 2 when the measurement came in - realized range 1,140 against a regime mean of 1,094, a compression of 1.04x rather than the predicted 0.55x. So on this day I expect a realized RANGE near the regime mean (frozen n0_range_20_mean = 1,266; expect roughly 1,150-1,300) sitting on top of a day-net of about 180, and I have built the p50 path to carry a real excursion rather than a flat holiday line. C reports the same play firing on 0616; this is its Juneteenth instance and its first FORWARD test on the day-class it was derived from.
days.confidence_reasoning: Low, and for one specific reason rather than general holiday vagueness: the instrument the doctrine names as the direction source is NULL on my D-1. 0618 session_signed_flow -1, session_b_share_two_sided 0.500 exactly. I am forecasting off the phase structure instead, which is real evidence but weaker, and which admits a second reading I could not eliminate (see evidence_used.the_alternative_I_could_not_kill). Two things pull confidence UP from where that alone would leave it: daytype.covering_giveback_self_limiting's trigger is met VERBATIM and its call is unambiguous, and three independent lines agree that the covering channel is disarmed at this seam. Two things hold it down: the null tilt, and the fact that the size of my number rests on a participation estimate I cannot verify.

2_my_own_cot_residual_instrument_returns.instrument: the corrected COT residual test I proposed and E applied: consumption window = all SESSIONS from publication_ts to the candidate seam, testing for a CROSS to cumulative net-positive signed flow.
2_my_own_cot_residual_instrument_returns.at_the_0614_seam_E_s_case: Sessions in the window: ZERO. Publication was 0612 15:30 ET and the seam is the 0614 18:00 reopen, so the window is 90 minutes of one session. UNCONSUMED - and I want to sharpen E's reasoning here rather than just agree with it: E said the window was 'far too short to CROSS'. The instrument is SESSION-grained, so the correct statement is that ZERO qualifying sessions elapsed and the test cannot return anything else. That is a structural property, not a measurement, and it means the instrument can never disarm a seam that immediately follows publication. Naming that limitation is worth more than the agreement.
2_my_own_cot_residual_instrument_returns.at_the_0619_seam_my_case: Sessions in the window: FOUR (0615, 0616, 0617, 0618). Cumulative session_signed_flow = +378 - 624 + 1,162 - 1 = +915. CROSSED NET-POSITIVE. Verdict: CONSUMED.
2_my_own_cot_residual_instrument_returns.the_basis_caveat_I_owe_this_number: The +915 spans the n0/n1 store change. Split by basis: n0 sub-window (0615, 0616) = -246, does NOT cross; n1 sub-window (0617, 0618) = +1,161, crosses cleanly. Neither two-session sub-window is decisive alone. The aggregate crosses, and the leg ADJACENT to my day - n1 - is the one that crosses. I report the verdict as CONSUMED at medium confidence with the basis stated, not as a clean number.
2_my_own_cot_residual_instrument_returns.why_this_matters: This is the first affirmative CONSUMED the instrument has ever returned. On G19 and G20 it returned UNCONSUMED both times, which meant it had never actually discriminated - it had only ever agreed with the play that was already firing. This is its first real test and it answers the question the run directive put to me.

3_the_D_minus_1_tape_0618_the_EIA_print_.what_it_says: n_trades 22,490, volume 46,452 lots (n1 store), session_signed_flow -1, session_b_share_two_sided 0.500 exactly. Phase signed flow +201 / +2,192 / -2,394. Phase two-sided b_share 0.548 / 0.554 / 0.420. big_print_b_share 0.303 size-weighted on 19 prints. l1_book quote_bid_share 0.491, spread_ticks_med 2.0.
3_the_D_minus_1_tape_0618_the_EIA_print_.the_read: A mildly BULLISH print was bought and then given back entirely. The 0618 print was +73 Bcf against a 75 consensus (surprise -2) and 5 Bcf UNDER the 5-year-normal build - it trimmed the vs-5yr surplus for the first time in the block (119 -> 114, after the 0611 print blew it out by +33). The market bought that in phase 2 (+2,192, two-sided 0.554) and sold ALL of it back in phase 3 (-2,394, two-sided 0.420, the session's most one-sided phase), finishing at a net of exactly -1. A market that cannot hold a bullish print has supply above it.
3_the_D_minus_1_tape_0618_the_EIA_print_.the_play_this_resembles_and_why_I_only_A: structure.failed_rally_tell is the right shape, but it reads a PRICE round-trip (close >=~60% off the counter extreme) and I have no price. What I have is the FLOW analogue: phase 2's +2,192 buy more than fully reversed by phase 3's -2,394, a 109% flow round-trip. That is a declared SUBSTITUTION, not the play's stated input, and the play's own record warns it has 'never been tested at up-polarity' and took a polarity-input error in G11. So I used it as an ARM on the sign, never as an owner, and I have labelled the substitution.
3_the_D_minus_1_tape_0618_the_EIA_print_.the_big_print_channel_stood_DOWN_not_use: flow.price_free_absorption_proxy's precondition is aggregate session signed flow POSITIVE. 0618 is -1, which is not positive, and the proxy's mirror arm under a negative/flat tape is EXPLICITLY REFUTED in its own text. So the 0.303 big-print reading carries no next-session information under that play and I did not use it as one. I used it only as weak corroboration of the phase-3 read, discounted by the thin-tape dispersion argument (19 prints, see cross_cutting finding 4).

4_the_discriminator_that_kept_my_sign_do.the_alternative_I_could_not_kill: 0618 phase 3's -2,394 has two readings. (i) INFORMATIONAL: supply above the market, a failed post-print rally, and 0619 carries the sell. (ii) MECHANICAL: front-leg roll selling at dte 5 pulled forward by a deadline participant facing a truncated Friday and a three-day gap - carrying no level information at all, in which case 0619's residual is roll-completion RELIEF and the day is flat-to-up. Reading (ii) is exactly what E measured on 0612 with the index roll, one week earlier.
4_the_discriminator_that_kept_my_sign_do.the_blind_available_test_I_ran: If phase 3 were pure front-leg roll selling I would expect the same signature on 0617, also inside the roll window at dte 6 and on the same n1 store. 0617's phases are -108 / +1,127 / +143 - phase 3 is mildly POSITIVE. There is no persistent front-leg sell signature across the two n1 sessions, which argues FOR reading (i).
4_the_discriminator_that_kept_my_sign_do.why_it_is_not_decisive: Roll flow accelerates non-linearly into the final days and the holiday pulls it forward, so 0618 being the concentration burst while 0617 was not is entirely consistent with reading (ii).
